fusions.name: Errand Without End
fusions.desc: Flings a pebble kicked up at a run for 7 damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%. It holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Drumming Run
fusions.desc: A drumming charge deals 12 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you and knocks them 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Road-Wise
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
